title: RFC 3234 is an informational taxonomy of middleboxes, not a standard that forbids them
summary: RFC 3234 is an informational taxonomy of middleboxes, not a standard that forbids them.
body: RFC 3234, Middleboxes: Taxonomy and Issues, says it provides information for the Internet community and does not specify an Internet standard of any kind. The source says: "Brim February 2002 Middleboxes: Taxonomy and Issues Status of this Memo This memo provides information for the Internet community." A middlebox, in that memo's framing, is a device in the path that does more than forward packets. The memo classifies them. It does not, by its own header, ban them or define one mandatory behavior.
said_by: B. Carpenter and S. Brim, RFC 3234
